announcements.headline: Directorate Changes
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a change in the board composition, which is a standard governance event that may influence strategic oversight but typically lacks immediate financial impact. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on the specific roles and responsibilities of the new directors.

announcements.headline: Result of 2026 Annual General Meeting
